overview_description.description:
Get rewarded from your favorite places!

Gathering all paper loyalty cards into one application. 

We bring you a selection of great rewards from some lovely independent retailers across Egypt & UK. All you need to do is download the app and keep shopping at the places you love. 

How it works: 
* Discover merchants near you that offer Zeal. 
* Get a punch on your card every time you spend the minimum charge.
* Redeem rewards whenever you want! 
* Birthday rewards from the places you love.

product.name: Zeal Smart Card Machine Integration
product.description: Transforms existing card machines to identify customers, offer loyalty rewards, and provide actionable insights during transactions.

product.name: Zeal Loyalty Options
product.description: Provides multiple loyalty program implementations on card machines, including standalone, linked to existing apps, or via Zeal’s own loyalty app.

product.name: Zeal Merchant Dashboard and Analytics
product.description: A dashboard providing merchants with real-time reports, customer segmentation, transaction history, and actionable insights from card machine data.

product.name: Zeal Customer Feedback Collection
product.description: Enables card machines to collect customer feedback at the point of sale, linked to transactions and branded for merchants.

identifier.value: Zeal Payment Provider Integration and Value-Added Services

product.name: Zeal Payment Provider Integration and Value-Added Services
product.description: Enables payment providers to activate Zeal on card machines, offering merchants loyalty, customer insights, and new revenue streams without hardware changes.
